# olivares_server_info (Data Source)

Reads the Olivares AI control plane server metadata (version, engine, license), read-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "olivares_server_info" "this" {}

output "control_plane_version" {
  value = data.olivares_server_info.this.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `engine` (String) Storage engine identifier.
- `license_licensee` (String) Licensee.
- `license_status` (String) License status.
- `setup_required` (Boolean) Whether first-run setup is still required.
- `version` (String) Control plane version.
